summary: Read the Town of Stavely Facilities page: 15 fully serviced sites, water hookup in summer, C$40/day (weekly/monthly on request), first come first served, season May long weekend - Oct 1. Amps, showers and dump not stated (stored derived values left). Not waterfront confirmed; pin OK.
